hero.title: Holy Mosque Views, Verified Floor by Floor
hero.body: Manzili built the browser-based 3D twin, sales gallery hardware and sales training for Erth Real Estate Development's SAR 2B+ three-tower development in Makkah's Masar Destination.

sidebar: Masar Ma’ab · 3 luxury residential and hospitality towers, up to 31 floors · 81,000+ m² built-up living area · over SAR 2 billion
WebGL digital twin · Sales gallery touch tables · Sales team training

challenge.title: Selling Holy City Residences Off-Plan
challenge.body: Selling luxury residences 850 meters from the Holy Mosque means proving floor heights, orientation toward the Haram and links to the pedestrian concourse. Static brochures and 2D plans couldn't justify floor-by-floor premiums to private and institutional investors.
rows: Buyers question high-floor premiums without verified views.
Verified view analysis: 3D elevations show the exact Holy Mosque and concourse sightlines from every floor.
Static maps can't show how Masar's central boulevard connects to the towers.
Masterplan-to-unit navigation: buyers explore district access, parking and pedestrian concourses in 3D.
GCC and international buyers want to verify remotely before they commit.
No-install web access: the WebGL twin streams to remote buyers through a secure link.

solution.title: An Interactive 3D Twin with Holy Mosque Sightlines
solution.body: One twin runs on the showroom touch tables and streams to buyers' browsers. It models all three towers with architectural precision, sun orientation and direct pedestrian concourse links.

blocks.title: View & Sightline Verification
points: Camera positions model the exact view from each floor toward the Holy Mosque concourse.
Removes buyer doubt about view premiums across all three towers.

blocks.title: Masar Destination Context
points: Includes Masar's 3.6 km boulevard, high-speed rail access and underground bus stops.
Shows walking times and transport options directly from the residences.

blocks.title: Turnkey Sales Gallery Hardware
points: Commercial 65-inch 4K touch tables installed in Erth's sales center.
Fast touch response for group presentations and investor reviews.

blocks.title: Remote Sharing by Web Link
points: Agents send personalized, unit-specific 3D walkthroughs to overseas buyers.
Nothing to install on the investor's side.

enablement.title: A Structured Journey for Luxury Investors
enablement.body: Manzili trained Erth's sales team in floor rehearsals to guide high-net-worth buyers from the masterplan to a unit reservation.

steps.title: District Orientation
steps.body: Advisors open on the Masar Destination twin, showing proximity to the Holy Mosque, concourse links and transit connections.

steps.title: Tower Selection & View Check
steps.body: The advisor isolates Tower 1, 2 or 3 and rotates it to show sun orientation, privacy buffers and verified views.

steps.title: Floor Plan & Finish Confirmation
steps.body: The interface moves into 3D floor plans with layouts, hospitality-grade finishes and live unit availability.
